title: Scout relevance holdout label set
description: Blind labels produced by assay and read by `scout holdout release --labels`. A label joins to a pending hold on holdout_id and evaluation_id against the frozen project; an identity that does not match a pending hold is rejected rather than guessed at.

packet.description: Which blind packet these labels came from. Provenance for the release, not a join key.

label.description: The resolved human label. `exclusion` means a hard exclusion applied; the other three are where the substance sits when nothing was excluded. Release maps exclusion and none to drop, in_post to respond, and pointer to review.

exclusion_name.description: Which exclusion fired, when label is `exclusion`. Provenance only; release reads `label`.

labelled_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant. When a case carries more than one label the last by this instant wins; an exact tie is rejected rather than broken arbitrarily.
